summary: iter30 Batch B multi-industry dashboards — frontend-only test. All 4 new owner dashboards (hospitality/transport/healthcare/retail) render with 100% of required data-testids present, correct industry-aware sidebar labels (Food Safety/Team Members/VenueInduct/VenueCheck etc.) and correct active-NAV left-border colour accents (#E87722 amber, #0DC4B5 teal, #2196A6 blue, #A855F7 purple, #FFCC00 yellow for trades). Trades owner dashboard preserved unchanged with eyebrow '/ Overview · Trades and Construction'. Cleanup PATCHed back to industry=trades, role_variant=owner. Backend skipped per request.

integration_issues.issue: After PATCH /api/auth/me/industry with role_variant='safety_lead' (industry='healthcare') and reload, [data-testid='safety-lead-dashboard'] is NOT rendered AND [data-testid='healthcare-owner-dashboard'] IS still rendered. Same for role_variant='supervisor' (industry='hospitality') — supervisor-dashboard NOT found, hospitality-owner-dashboard still present. Suggests role_variant from PATCH is not being persisted/returned by /api/auth/me, OR the SafetyLead/Supervisor dashboards use a different testid than 'safety-lead-dashboard'/'supervisor-dashboard'. Dashboard.jsx logic does check variant before industry (lines 60-67), so most likely a backend persistence or testid-mismatch issue.

action_items: Investigate why PATCH /api/auth/me/industry with role_variant='safety_lead'/'supervisor' does not switch the rendered dashboard. Confirm (a) PATCH actually updates role_variant in DB, (b) /api/auth/me returns updated role_variant after reload, (c) SafetyLeadDashboard and SupervisorDashboard root elements actually carry data-testid='safety-lead-dashboard' / 'supervisor-dashboard'.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx role-variant routing happens BEFORE industry routing — correct order. But the smoke test failed; needs verification whether testids on those two dashboards match the spec.
DashboardLayout.jsx industryAccent only applied to top-level NAV items (renderedNav loop), not to apps/safety/workflow/library NAV groups — that's per-spec since brief says 'active NavLink only'.

All 4 new dashboards correctly use real /compliance/score, /incidents, /workers, /licences endpoints. Placeholder data (fleet rego, equipment temps, AHPRA rows etc.) is intentional per Batch C+D scope.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (47/47 testids + 24/24 sidebar items present; 2/2 role-variant smoke tests failed)

seed_data_creation: None. Used PATCH /api/auth/me/industry to switch industries; cleanup reset to trades/owner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Token key is 'st_token' (NOT 'token' or 'auth_token'). PATCH endpoint is /api/auth/me/industry and accepts {industry, role_variant} in same payload. After PATCH always reload /dashboard to pick up new user from /api/auth/me. All 4 industry dashboards have full data-testid coverage matching spec. Only outstanding issue is role_variant override: confirm SafetyLeadDashboard/SupervisorDashboard root testid names.
rca of the issue: Smoke test for role_variant override (safety_lead/supervisor with non-trades industry) failed to find the variant dashboard testids. Either (a) those dashboards don't carry the documented data-testid, or (b) role_variant isn't persisted by the PATCH route. Industry PATCH itself works (status 200, dashboard switches correctly), so the PATCH endpoint is partially functional.
